agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
October 22, 2024 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.

APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
PROCLAMATION FOR RED RIBBON WEEK - It is recommended the City Council proclaim October 21 through October 25, 2024 as Red Ribbon Week in the City of La Mirada and present a proclamation to Public Safety Officer Cristina Garcia.
5.1 Proclamation
5.2
RECOGNITION OF PUBLIC SAFETY POSTER CONTEST WINNERS - It is recommended the City Council and a representative of the Public Safety and Traffic Commission recognize the winners of the Public Safety Poster Contest and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.2 PS Poster Contest
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT: (Any information or materials provided during Public Comments are recorded in the minutes and are subject to public disclosure under the Public Records Act. The speaker is requested, but is not required, to orally state his or her name and/or address for purposes of recording the information accurately in the minutes. If the speaker declines to provide his or her name, address, and other relevant information, the records will so indicate. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council.)
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENT TO THE LA MIRADA COMMUNITY FOUNDATION – It is recommended the City Council appoint Julio Jacobo to the La Mirada Community Foundation for a term ending in May 2025.
7.1 Appointment to the Foundation
7.2
REAPPOINTMENTS TO THE LA MIRADA YOUTH COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council reappoint Isabelle Alejandre, Lianna Blancoromero, Katherine Jimenez, Ethan Hall, Miso Hong, Daniel Morales, Madison Souza, and Emma Vanden Dries to the La Mirada Youth Council for a term ending in October 2025.
7.2 Reappointments to YC
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of October 8, 2024 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of October 8, 2024.
8.1 Minutes of 10-8-24 SS
8.1 Minutes of 10-8-24 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated October 22, 2024 in the total amount of $2,530,014.34.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
MONTHLY TREASURER REPORT FOR THE PERIOD ENDING AUGUST 2024 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City of La Mirada Monthly Treasurer Report for the period ending August 2024.
8.3 Monthly Treasurer Report
8.4
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING SEPTEMBER 2024 – It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the period ending September 2024.
8.4 Investment Report
8.5
STRUCTURE LEASE AGREEMENT – NEW CINGULAR WIRELESS PCS, LLC - It is recommended the City Council approve the Structure Lease Agreement between the City of La Mirada and New Cingular Wireless PCS, LLC, subject to the lease agreement terms recommended by staff, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.5 Structure Lease Agr
8.6
AUTHORIZATION TO PURCHASE PUBLIC WORKS VEHICLES - It is recommended the City Council authorize the purchase of three Chevrolet Colorado RWD trucks from Selman Chevrolet in the amount of $36,700 per truck, for a total cost of $110,100.
8.6 Purchase of Vehicles
8.7
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2018-01, TELEGRAPH ROAD PAVEMENT REHABILITATION – LEFFINGWELL ROAD TO IMPERIAL HIGHWAY AND TRAFFIC SIGNAL UPGRADE AT SPRINGVIEW DRIVE – APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH CNC ENGINEERING FOR PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERING SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the On-Call Professional Services Agreement between the City of La Mirada and CNC Engineering to provide professional civil engineering services for CIP No. 2018-01, Telegraph Road Pavement Rehabilitation – Leffingwell Road to Imperial Highway and Traffic Signal Upgrade at Springview Drive, based on the CNC Engineering proposal dated August 9, 2024, in the amount of $61,470; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional professional services up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount, if required.
8.7 CIP No. 2018-01
8.8
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2019-01, CREEK PARK RENOVATION - APPROVAL OF AN AMENDMENT TO THE ON-CALL PROFESSIONAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH SOUTHSTAR ENGINEERING & CONSULTING, INC. FOR PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERING SERVICES - It is recommended the City Council approve and authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the on-call Professional Services Agreement with Southstar Engineering and Consulting, Inc. to perform a constructability review of the Creek Park renovation plans, based on their proposal in the amount of $53,473.36; and authorize the City Manager to approve additional professional services up to 20 percent of the authorized contract amount, if required.
8.8 CIP NO. 2019-01
